**Wednesday 4 November 2026, 6pm** ·
[Brighton AI](https://www.meetup.com/brighton-ai/events/317118222/) ·
Plus X Innovation, Lewes Road, Brighton

Part of Brighton AI's evening *What Could Sussex Solve with its Own Data,
AI, Modelling and Your Ideas?*

How far can modelling help a city plan its schools? Using Brighton &
Hove's secondary school system as a case study, this talk looks at what AI
and collective intelligence can add to applied urban modelling, drawing on
a model of the system built entirely from published data.

The model and its documentation:
[Brighton & Hove’s secondary school system](https://adamdennett.github.io/bh-school-system/).

The same talk, at other venues: the
[University of Glasgow](../2026-11-13-glasgow-geospatial-data-science/) and the
[University of Reading](../2026-11-18-reading-real-estate-and-planning/).
